BiblicalUsage: The name is Ribai, an Israelite. You find the name in 1 Chronicles 11:31, "Ithai the son of Ribai of Gibeah, to…", and again in 2 Samuel 23:29.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Ribai matters because God names his people one by one, and none of them is forgotten. I hold that no name in Scripture is there by accident.
